Context: on service matters

- OMs, dated 1-11-1999 and 6-6-2013.  
- (3) Representation on service matters by relatives should be discouraged.Provision of Rule 20 of CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964 prohibits Government servants from bringing outside influence in respect of matter pertaining to his service matter (with some exceptions). Representation by relatives of Government servant is also treated as outside influence.  
- OMs, dated 19-9-1963 and 31-8-2015.
